desc:
The Ops-Core AMP Helmet Rail Mount Kit allows for the mounting of the AMP Communication Headset to a helmet system with the Ops-Core ARC Rails. The helmet mount rail kit mounts to the rear of the ARC rails to allow for the top portion of the rails to remain free for mounting accessories such as lights and other accessories.

Mounting the Ops-Core AMP Communication Headset to the rear of the helmet improves stabilization and provides a natural counterbalance to the weight of night vision.

A single point gimbal attachment to the ear cups allow for 360 degree adjustment, which not only allows for better fitment and seal to the user’s unique ear / head shape, but maintains that seal and moves more naturally with head movement.

Ear cups rotate to the side or rear of helmet when not in use, streamlining stowage to create a very low profile.
